en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the interior of a grand glass-and-iron spa hall with tall arched windows and ornate decoration. In the center stands a large classical statue above a spring opening, around which workers—mostly women in aprons—are filling bottles and crates with mineral water. On the right, there is printed red German text describing the scene and publisher information at the bottom.
